observations: Photo 0 shows a black, vintage-style sewing machine on a matching black metal stand.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right, a needle and presser foot assembly, and a foot pedal with a metal plate at the bottom.
The stand has a decorative, ornate metal frame with a central spindle and a foot pedal mechanism.
The machine appears to be in good condition with no visible damage or rust.
The background is plain white, suggesting a studio or stock photo.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'BASARINDE OLUVU' overlaid on the image.

claims.claim: Fairly used singer sewing machine for sale!
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
Photo 0 shows only the machine head and stand; no accessories or internal components are visible. The 'working perfectly' claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.
The flat plate is not visible in photo 0. The seller's text mentions it, but it is not shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.

risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

Video or photo showing the machine in operation.
